name: to-claude
description: Hand this conversation to Claude Code so the user can keep going there. The first time it is imported and linked; after that the linked Claude conversation is opened. Use when the user says $to-claude, "switch to claude", "continue in claude", 切到 claude, 转给 claude, or is running out of Codex usage. Also when the user says "unlink", "stop syncing" or 取消关联.

findings.excerpt: This skill uses the `ccx` command from the ccx app (github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx). If `~/.local/bin/ccx` doesn't exist, tell the user to install ccx with `curl
